method: Each decision rests on interaction takes in the Dunwall safe room under the product controller, both source roles: the source uses the real native object with native input (the note through the native read state, food through the native LootObject47 pickup), the partner is checked from its own use presentation on the observer and the checkpoint is reloaded after every case; reviewed observer videos are listed per item. The objects themselves (the item taken, the note read) are world and inventory state: stage 5.

items.scope: Reading the table note in both roles: while the source reads, the partner holds the note out in a held reach and returns to its idle when the source closes it (coverage-v1318i on 1214cn; coverage-v1286e earlier).

visual.verdict: Emily lifts her left hand and holds the note out in front of her while she reads, then lowers it and stands at ease.

items.scope: Eating native food (grapes) in both roles: the native pickup presents the use reach toward the plate on the partner, and the item is taken. D2 eats food instantly on pickup without a first-person eating motion, so the reach is the faithful gesture. Drinking elixirs is presented hand to mouth (health_elixir).

visual.verdict: Emily steps to the table and reaches down to the plate, then straightens.
